name: blender-vse
title_zh: 在 Blender 工程里改视频，不碰你的手工调整
tagline_zh: 当 .blend 工程是唯一真相时，安全读取、续剪、渲染、挂代理，四个有界工具守住你的手工修改。
tagline_en: When a .blend VSE project is the source of truth, safely inspect, resume, render, attach proxies, and verify—four.
desc_en: Use when a named .blend Video Sequence Editor project is the source of truth or the required editable deliverable. Safely inspect or edit the project, resume earlier work, render the timeline, attach externally generated proxies, and verify persistence with four bounded, revision-safe local MCP tools while preserving human changes. For end-to-end production, pair this execution Skill with an avail
why_zh: 四个工具都带修订保护，只动你点名要改的，人做的调整原样保留；比直接开 Blender 乱点稳。
why_en: Four revision-safe MCP tools only touch what you ask, preserving manual changes—more controlled than raw Blender, more editable.
limit_zh: 只认 Blender 的 VSE 工程，不碰其他剪辑软件；代理需外部生成，本技能不负责转码；渲染输出到哪一步为止。
limit_en: Only works on Blender VSE .blend projects. Proxies must be pre-generated externally. Renders stop at file output—no publishing. No .blend, no go.
title_en: Edit video inside Blender projects without touching your.
